title: Prompt Refinement or Fine-tuning? Best Practices for using LLMs in Computational Social Science Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the classification accuracy of Large Language Models on subsets of the SOCKET benchmark, specifically testing their ability to detect text containing biased implications (the 'hasbiasedimplication' task) and stereotypical hate speech (the 'implicit-hate#stereotypical_hate' task).
